actions.createMessage.description: Post a plain text or rich text message to a Webex room or send a direct message
actions.createMessage.props.files.descri: Public URLs to files to attach (only one file per message)
actions.createMessage.props.markdown.des: The message in Markdown format for rich text. If provided, text will be used as alternate text
Choose between sending to a room or a direct message to a person
actions.createMessage.props.parentId.des: The parent message ID to reply to (optional)
actions.createRoom.description: Create a new Webex room (space). The authenticated user is automatically added as a member.
actions.createRoom.props.description.des: The description of the room. Required if isPublic is true.
actions.createRoom.props.isAnnouncementO: Sets the space into announcement mode. Only moderators can post messages. Note: space must be locked (moderated) to enable this.
actions.createRoom.props.isLocked.descri: Set the space as locked/moderated. The creator becomes a moderator.
actions.createRoom.props.isPublic.descri: Make the room public and discoverable within the org. Note: description is required if this is true.
actions.createRoom.props.teamId.descript: The ID for the team with which this room is associated (optional)
actions.createRoom.props.title.descripti: A user-friendly name for the room
actions.createTeam.description: Create a new Webex team. The authenticated user is automatically added as a member.
actions.createTeam.props.name.descriptio: A user-friendly name for the team
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.findMessage.description: Retrieve details for a specific message by message ID
actions.findMessage.props.messageId.desc: The unique identifier for the message
actions.findRoom.description: Retrieve details for a specific room by room id
triggers.newMeeting.description: Triggers when a new meeting is created.
triggers.newRoom.description: Triggers when a new room is created
